# ORSPEX PDF Compressor

> Free, browser-based PDF compressor. Files are compressed locally on the user's device — nothing is uploaded to any server.

## Links

- Web App: https://orspex-pdf-compressor.vercel.app/
- Source: https://github.com/orpexexitus-maker/orspex-pdf-compressor

## Features

- 100% client-side compression with pdf-lib
- No uploads, no signup, no watermark
- Works on Windows, macOS, Linux, Chromebook, iPad
